cb_hook: Build a·f(b(x − c)) + d one step at a time.
cb_stage_aria: Graph of f with combined transformations: {title}
cb_step_intro_caption: Every shift and stretch fits into one formula. Let's build it.
cb_step_build_c_caption: First c = 2: the graph moves right by 2.
cb_step_build_b_caption: Then b = 2 squeezes it toward the line x = c.
cb_step_build_a_caption: a = −1.5 stretches the heights and flips them.
cb_step_order_predict_caption: Where does the peak of f(2x − 1) land? Drag the marker there.
cb_step_order_answer_caption: f(2x − 1) = f(2(x − ½)): only half the shift. Factor out b first!
cb_step_explore_caption: Drag the graph, the peak or the sliders. Try other base graphs too.
